description: Left from a 2026-10-04 scan of load-fragile tests (the gate now prints its load and re-run lines on a red run). Timing is the subject, left to the load note: daemon/lifecycle.rs:14 (25 ms first answer), daemon/streams.rs:319, daemon/doorbell.rs:270 and :613; bridge/link.rs:233 uses production LOST_AGAIN_WITHIN.
title: A few seam and CLI waits still race a busy machine
